## Summary

Describe the problem and the change.

## Verification

List the commands and results used to verify the change, for example:

```text
npm test
npm run webpack:headless
```

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused on one problem.
- [ ] Tests cover the behavior change where applicable.
- [ ] Documentation is updated when user-visible behavior changes.
- [ ] No generated files (`dist/`, `out/`, VSIX archives) are committed.
